capabilities: Summarize video links, local media files and pasted transcripts into notes with key points and timestamped transcripts
Fetch platform subtitles or run speech-to-text when a video has none
Play videos beside their transcript with click-to-seek and highlights
Generate flashcards and questions with a local review schedule
Search across transcripts and compare claims between multiple videos
extras: Desktop only (Obsidian 1.11.4+); plugin and backend are free, the summary model is billed per token. Includes a bundled Chromium browser extension for capturing videos. Warns that the webhook secret is stored unencrypted in data.json and that evidence/learning data under the plugin's data/ folder should be backed up or removed before sharing a vault. Manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to turn videos into structured notes, so users must transcribe and summarize them by hand.

relations.evidence: n8n with yt-dlp and ffmpeg in Docker on your own computer, started by the script
DeepSeek deepseek-flash by default, or any OpenAI-compatible model
SiliconFlow SenseVoiceSmall, used only for videos without subtitles and for local audio or video

requires.name: Docker Desktop or OrbStack running the bundled n8n backend
Summary model billed per token by provider

summary: Turns video links, local recordings and pasted transcripts into notes with a summary, key points and a timestamped transcript, via a local Docker backend.
